title: GitHub Actions pinned by tag rather than commit SHA

evidence.description: permissions limited to contents:read, pages:write, id-token:write
Triggers are push to master and manual only

reason: Only GitHub-owned actions are used, the token is least-privilege, no secrets are exposed to the workflow and no untrusted trigger exists; tag pinning of first-party actions is accepted hardening, not a vulnerability.

title: High-severity npm audit advisories in dependency tree
description: npm audit reports 7 high and 1 moderate advisories.
claimed_root_cause: Vulnerable vite, postcss, nanoid, js-yaml, brace-expansion, browserslist, source-map-js versions in the lockfile.

trace.description: Build tooling resolved from the lockfile
Advisory-affected versions installed in CI and locally

evidence.description: Build runs vite build then postbuild.mjs; only dist/ is deployed

reason: Advisories affect the dev server, CSS/source-map parsing of attacker-supplied input, or tooling not shipped in dist/. The build parses only first-party files, so no attacker-controlled input reaches them. Hygiene: npm audit fix is available.

title: No CSP or security headers configured for the deployed site
description: The site is deployed to GitHub Pages and the repo carries no header or CSP configuration. Whether a CDN in front of the custom domain adds headers cannot be seen from source.
claimed_root_cause: No Content-Security-Policy, frame-ancestors or HSTS policy is defined in the repo (no meta CSP in index.html, no _headers file).

trace.description: HTML shell served without a repo-defined CSP meta tag
dist/ is published to GitHub Pages, which does not accept custom response headers

evidence.description: Head has an inline redirect script and a Google Fonts stylesheet but no CSP meta

blockers: Live response headers of mamio-baby-tracker.com are not observable without contacting the deployment, which the audit forbids
Unknown whether a CDN or proxy fronts the custom domain and sets headers

validation_plan.deployment: Owner runs curl -sI https://mamio-baby-tracker.com/en/ once and records content-security-policy, strict-transport-security and x-frame-options. If absent, decide between a meta CSP (needs inline-script hash for the redirect script and fonts.googleapis.com/fonts.gstatic.com allowance) or fronting with a header-setting CDN. Impact is low: the site has no user data, forms or auth.

title: Open redirect via locale redirect script
description: Claimed open redirect in the inline locale redirect.
claimed_root_cause: window.location.replace target derived from URL input.

trace.description: Runs only when pathname is exactly "/"

evidence.description: supportedLocales fixed to en, de, tr
Target is origin-relative and begins with a single slash followed by a fixed locale

reason: The locale is chosen from a fixed allowlist and the URL begins "/" + locale + "/", so scheme and host are not controllable; query and hash are appended unchanged to the same origin.

title: Reverse tabnabbing through store links
description: Claimed missing rel=noopener on target=_blank links.

evidence.description: rel="noreferrer" set on the link, which implies noopener
Link targets are fixed apple/google store constants

reason: All eight target=_blank anchors set rel="noreferrer" and point to fixed first-party store URLs, so window.opener is not exposed.

title: Third-party stylesheet loaded without integrity
description: Google Fonts CSS is loaded from fonts.googleapis.com.

trace.description: Applies fetched CSS to the page

evidence.description: Stylesheet only; no third-party script is loaded anywhere in index.html or public/

reason: Dynamic Google Fonts CSS cannot carry SRI and a stylesheet cannot execute script; impact is limited to styling. Any EU privacy angle is outside a security finding.
